posts.title: Standard Equation: $y^2 = 4ax$
posts.body: A parabola is the locus of a point whose distance from the focus $(a, 0)$ equals its perpendicular distance from the directrix $x = -a$. Here eccentricity $e = 1$.
posts.analogy: Like a satellite dish focusing every parallel incoming signal ray onto a single detector point.
posts.subject: Maths
